programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Tha Sif, Pipp agus Bran a’ cleachdadh foidhle gus long-fhànais a chruthachadh. Ziff, Pipp and Button use kitchen foil to create and launch an out-of-this-world spaceship.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Otto a feuchainn ri toirt air Oona gun a bhith cho eagallach mun dorchadas 's e ga brosnachadh a dhol chun na traghad le fhèin... tron oidhche! Otto attempts to help Oona get over a fear of the dark by encouraging her to take a special trip to the beach by herself... a night-time trip!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha i air a bhith sileadh gu trom air a chreag 's a-nis tha poll anns gach àit'! Tha Mama airson 's gun cùm Oona sùil air Baba 's gun cùm i glan e - obair dhùbhlanach 's Baba airson leum 's na loin 's coimhead sna lochain! It has been raining heavily on the rock and now there's mud everywhere. Mama has asked Oona to watch Baba and to keep him nice and clean - a big challenge, as Baba wants to jump in muddy puddles and investigate the pond life.

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha màthair Pheicein a’ trod ris às dèidh dha a ràdh ri nurs gu bheil a sròn mòr. Bhon mhionaid sin, tha Peicein a’ tòiseachadh ri breugan beaga innse, is tha iad sin a’ sìor fhàs nam breugan mòra, is ag adhbharrachadh mì-thuigse uabhasach! Petit's mum scolds him for telling a nurse that she has a big nose. From that moment on, Petit starts telling white lies that grow little by little, until they turn into big lies and cause a huge misunderstanding.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Tha Ben agus na h-Abadas a' cluich an geama fhaclan 's Ben ag iarraidh orra bara-cuibhle a lorg. Tha Hari, Seren 's Ella uile den bheachd gun tig aca air am facal ùr a lorg ach cò thig a thaghadh an-diugh? Ben plays the word game with the Abadas and sends them on a search for a wheelbarrow. Hari, Seren and Ela all believe they can find out the meaning of the word, but who will go on the adventure?

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachd do chlann òga. Tha Coinneach MacFhraing a’ leughadh Am Mapa Gealaich Mìorbhaileach. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Teresa Heapy, a dhealbhachadh le David Litchfield agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Morag Stiùbhart. Coinneach Rankin reads Am Mapa Gealaich Mìorbhaileach by Teresa Heapy, illustrated by David Litchfield and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart.

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royals Next Door
programme.desc: Tha aig a' chlann ri diofar pheataichean a thoirt leotha dhan sgoil an-diugh oir ‘s e Là Bi-iomadachd a th’ann. Tha Stella feumach air taic – saoil an tèid Mgr P ann còmhla rithe? The children have to take different pets to school as it’s Biodiversity Day. Stella needs help, but will Mgr P go with her?

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royals Next Door
programme.desc: Tha an dealbh Rìoghail dol a bhith air a thogail a-nochd ach, gu mì-fhortanach, tha cùisean air a dhol ceàrr le Stella. Tha trioblaid dathadh-fuilt ag adhbharachadh gu bheil falt Stella air a mhilleadh. Dè chanas an Rìgh 's a' Bhànrigh? The Royal portrait is being taken tonight but, unfortunately, things have gone awry for Stella. A dye incident has meant that her hair is ruined. What will the King and Queen say?

programme.title: Clann Na Cruinne
programme.desc: Tha Hanka aona bhliadhna-deug, à Slobhagia, ‘s bidh i a' dol don aon sgoil san t-saoghal a tha a’ teagasg seabhagaireachd mar phàirt den churraicealam àbhaisteach. Hanka is 11, from Slovakia, and she attends the only school in the world where falconry is taught as part of the regular curriculum.

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Nuair tha Fèill Achadh an t-Samhraidh dol a bhith ann, tha Camshron a’ fuireach aig an tuathanas còmhla ri Belle is Sebastian ach chan eil Sebastian a' smaoineachadh gu bheil e uabhasach onarach. When Summer Pasture Ceremony is about to take place, Cameron stays at the farmhouse with Belle and Sebastian, but Sebastian thinks that he is being insincere.

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha an taigh ri sgeadachadh ach tha Bitzer feumach air taic nuair tha e air fhàgail os cionn ghnothaichean. Ach 's e barrachd bacadh tha e a' faighinn bhon threud seach cuideachadh - abair bùrach! When the farmer pops out for more supplies, Bitzer is left in charge of decorating and calls on the flock for help. He soon realises this may be a terrible mistake, as they have their own way of doing things - painting and decorating isn't their strong point!

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: ’S urrainn dhut ge bith dè an seòrsa brunch as fheàrr leat a ghabhail, ach tha Bobhla Acai luma-làn maitheas agus gu math ùrachail. You can have any kind of brunch you like, but an acai bowl is packed with goodness and very refreshing. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Machair
programme.desc: Drama Gàidhlig stèidhichte ann an Leòdhas. Gaelic soap based on the Isle of Lewis.

programme.title: Slighe Naoimh Cuithbeirt/St Cuthbert's Way
programme.desc: Iagan MacNèill a’leantail Slighe Naoimh Chuithbeirt a St Boswells gu Lilliardsedge. Iagan MacNeil explores the St Cuthbert’s Way, from St Boswells to Lilliardsedge.

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc: Ramsay meets writer and producer Maureen MacLeod just north of Glasgow to enjoy the nature right on their doorstep. The pair follow the popular West Highland Way route as Maureen talks about the importance of home and how that has shaped her career. She opens up about her passion for travel and visiting new places, but also the tough reality of travelling to hostile environments. Tha Ramsay MacMahon air ais leis an dàrna sreath de Rathad Ramsay, far a bheil e a’ coinneachadh ri Gàidheil aithnichte air feadh na dùthcha airson cuairt, còmhradh agus cnuasachadh. Tha Ramsay a’ coinneachadh ris an sgrìobhadair agus an riochdaire, Maureen NicLeòid, dìreach tuath air Glaschu gus an rud as fheàrr a dhèanamh dhen nàdar air an starsaich. Tha an dithis a’ leantainn Slighe na Gàidhealtachd an Iar fhad ’s a tha Maureen a’ bruidhinn mu cho cudromach ’s a tha a dachaigh dhi agus mar a thug e buaidh air a cuid obrach. Tha i ag innse mun ùidh mhòr a th’ aice ann a bhith a’ siubhal agus a’ tadhal air àiteachan ùra, ach cuideachd mu cho doirbh ’s a tha e a bhith a’ siubhal gu sgìrean nàimhdeil. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Skerryvore Aig Caisteal Floors
programme.desc: Cuirm shònraichte a’ comharrachadh 20 bliadhna de Skerryvore ann an àrainn àlainn Caisteal Floors, Cealsaidh, sna Crìochan. Tha an còmhlan ainmeil Albannach air a bhith am meadhan saoghal ceòl na h-Alba airson dà dheichead. A bharrachd air aoighean sònraichte, còmhlain is caraidean, bidh nam mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig a’ chuirm as motha aca riamh. Air a lìbhrigeadh le Megan NicGill-Fhaolain. A special concert recorded at Floors Castle to celebrate 20 years of Skerryvore. The legendary Scottish band have been at the forefront of Scotland’s music scene for two decades and are joined by special guests, bands and friends, as well as thousands of fans, for their biggest ever show. Presented by Megan MacLellan. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Belladrum
programme.desc: Là 2 de Belladrum 2025 agus tha Fiona NicChoinnich is Niall Iain Dòmhnallach a’ cur fàilt’ air Beluga Lagoon mar phrìomh chòmhlan Àrd-Ùrlar a’ Ghàrraidh. Stèidhichte leis a’ chruthaiche-film, Andrew O’Donnell, thug cruth-tìre brèagha na h-Alba buaidh air na h-òrain aige, a’ coisinn luchd-leantainn dìleas dhan chòmhlan agus tha iad air cuid de na h-ionadan-ciùil as samhlachail san dùthaich a lìonadh. Day two of Belladrum and Fiona MacKenzie and Niall Iain Macdonald welcome Beluga Lagoon to headline the Garden Stage. The band was founded by Scottish wildlife film-maker Andrew O’Donnell whose songs, inspired by the beauty of Scotland’s landscapes, have gained the band a dedicated following.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Featuring an appearance by Blue Rose Code, a band that blends Celtic soul, jazz, and rock to winning effect.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: Narrowboater and film-maker Robbie Cumming crosses the Pennines on the picturesque Leeds and Liverpool Canal, and lends a hand to hire boaters in Gargrave, North Yorkshire. He also encounters Bingley Five Rise Locks, a wonder of the inland waterways.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo reaches England’s south coast to continue his exploration of postwar Britain. He begins in Dorset on the Swanage Railway, riding a glorious 1940s steam locomotive on the trail of one of Britain’s most popular children’s authors, Enid Blyton. In Poole, Michael discovers an icon of the Swinging Sixties – the lava lamp, invented in the town by an eccentric accountant. At Romsey, Michael heads to the magnificent Broadlands Estate, once home of Louis Mountbatten, first Earl Mountbatten of Burma. Michael’s last stop on this leg of the journey is Portchester, on the northern edge of Portsmouth Harbour, where he visits a factory manufacturing a marine craft pioneered in the 1950s – the hovercraft.

programme.title: Gods and Monsters: Homer's Odyssey
programme.desc: Virginia Woolf said that Homer's epic poem the Odyssey was 'alive to every tremor and gleam of existence'. Following the magical and strange adventures of warrior king Odysseus, inventor of the idea of the Trojan horse, the poem can claim to be the greatest story ever told. Now British poet Simon Armitage goes on his own Greek adventure, following in the footsteps of one of his own personal heroes. Yet Simon ponders the question of whether he even likes the guy.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: As the 80s come to a close, the Top of the Pops vaults open once more to offer up the movers, shakers and chart toppers of 1989. This compilation looks back at performances by established megastars Tina Turner and Phil Collins, all-conquering funki dreds Soul II Soul, dance queen Paula Abdul, northern soul girl Lisa Stansfield and wry vocal group The Beautiful South. Madchester favourites Stone Roses and Happy Mondays also put in an appearance along with Stock Aitken and Waterman stalwarts Kylie Minogue, Jason Donovan and Sonia, not forgetting Sydney Youngblood, Mike and The Mechanics, Rebel MC and Double Trouble, plus duets from strange bedfellows Marc Almond and Gene Pitney, and Linda Ronstadt and Aaron Neville.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Simon Bates and Richard Skinner present the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 4 July 1985. Featuring Tears for Fears, Simply Red, Dead or Alive, Fine Young Cannibals and The Damned.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Bruno Brookes presents the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 11 July 1991 and featuring OMD, Billy Bragg, Bros and Bryan Adams.

programme.title: Bonnie Tyler: In One Voice
programme.desc: A look back at the life of Skewen's most famous musical daughter, Bonnie Tyler. Including Total Eclipse of the Heart, It's a Heartache and Lost in France - three of Bonnie Tyler's biggest selling hits in the 1980s.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Compilation of some of the biggest hits of 1983 to sit alongside 'The Story of...' documentary that explores the evolution of this great pop institution in that golden year. Performances celebrate soul, reggae, jazz, new wave and pop. And the big hits are delivered by Wham!, KC and the Sunshine Band, The Police, Culture Club, Siouxsie and The Banshees, UB40, Duran Duran, The Beat and Bananarama amongst others. Big ballads are performed by Elton John and Bonnie Tyler, while Malcolm McLaren's Double Dutch completes the very best of '83, golden hits from 34 years ago.

programme.title: Words and Music
programme.desc: Tracey MacLeod introduces a series celebrating the art of songwriting in which classic pop songs are stripped back to basics and performed by their original composers. Iggy Pop - I Wanna Be Your Dog Richard Berry - Louie Louie Bee Gees - To Love Somebody Tony Joe Wright - Rainy Night in Georgia Sparks - This Town Ain't Big Enough for Both of Us Jimmy Webb - By the Time I Get to Phoenix Neil Finn - Don't Dream It's Over Debbie Harry and Chris Stein - Heart of Glass

programme.title: The Old Grey Whistle Test
programme.desc: Blondie perform live at the height of their powers in 1979 at the Apollo Theatre in Glasgow, with Debbie Harry wowing the audience with such hits as Dreaming, Union City Blue, Atomic, Picture This, Heart of Glass, Hanging on the Telephone and Sunday Girl.

programme.title: In Concert
programme.desc: American songwriter and performer Jimmy Webb sings some of his hit compositions, including All My Love's Laughter, By the Time I Get to Phoenix, Wichita Lineman and MacArthur Park.

programme.desc: BBC Music brings you The Glastonbury Experience 2021. A musical extravaganza celebrating the spirit, the performances and the magic of Worthy Farm and Glastonbury Festival

programme.desc: An expert witness uses fibre analysis to solve an execution-style murder, and after 26 years in prison, a man walks free when a forensic scientist links DNA to the real killer.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: We return to Norfolk to see if two brothers can finish transforming a pair of old farm cottages into one luxury home. Dion meets a developer in Northampton who has grand plans of his own, and in Kingston upon Thames, Jacqui likes the plans a new owner has for a one-bedroom flat.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Viewers will be checking their change after watching this episode in Kent! David Harper meets a coin collector who reveals which rare 50 pence piece is worth 300 times its face value! John Wilson’s collection boasts 11,000 coins, including early medieval and Tudor hammered coins and the very first milled ones from the 18th century. Hoping to splash some cash of their own at Detling antiques fair are two teams of bargain hunters. In red are mum and daughter Nisha and dancer Adzi, with their expert Mark Stacey. Their opponents in blue are partners and musicians Kathy and Nardo. Nardo used to play drums in 1980s band Amazulu, and Kathy worked with some big recording artists of the era. They hope to compose a win with expert Kate Bliss, kicking off with a dolphin water feature, but four figures is too much to splash out on. The reds, meanwhile, are pinning their hopes on a set of cameo brooches, but Mark has doubts whether they will prove popular at auction. In Windsor, David hears auctioneer Harry Ballin’s estimates before the teams see their items go under the hammer – for a profit or a loss!

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Viewers will be checking their change after watching this episode in Kent! David Harper meets a coin collector who reveals which rare 50 pence piece is worth 300 times its face value! John Wilson’s collection boasts 11,000 coins, including early medieval and Tudor hammered coins and the very first milled ones from the 18th century. Hoping to splash some cash of their own at Detling antiques fair are two teams of bargain hunters. In red are mum and daughter Nisha and dancer Adzi, with their expert Mark Stacey. Their opponents in blue are partners and musicians Kathy and Nardo. Nardo used to play drums in 1980s band Amazulu, and Kathy worked with some big recording artists of the era. They hope to compose a win with expert Kate Bliss, kicking off with a dolphin water feature, but four figures is too much to splash out on. The reds, meanwhile, are pinning their hopes on a set of cameo brooches, but Mark has doubts whether they will prove popular at auction. In Windsor, David hears auctioneer Harry Ballin’s estimates before the teams see their items go under the hammer – for a profit or a loss!

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: We return to Norfolk to see if two brothers can finish transforming a pair of old farm cottages into one luxury home. Dion meets a developer in Northampton who has grand plans of his own, and in Kingston upon Thames, Jacqui likes the plans a new owner has for a one-bedroom flat.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Viewers will be checking their change after watching this episode in Kent! David Harper meets a coin collector who reveals which rare 50 pence piece is worth 300 times its face value! John Wilson’s collection boasts 11,000 coins, including early medieval and Tudor hammered coins and the very first milled ones from the 18th century. Hoping to splash some cash of their own at Detling antiques fair are two teams of bargain hunters. In red are mum and daughter Nisha and dancer Adzi, with their expert Mark Stacey. Their opponents in blue are partners and musicians Kathy and Nardo. Nardo used to play drums in 1980s band Amazulu, and Kathy worked with some big recording artists of the era. They hope to compose a win with expert Kate Bliss, kicking off with a dolphin water feature, but four figures is too much to splash out on. The reds, meanwhile, are pinning their hopes on a set of cameo brooches, but Mark has doubts whether they will prove popular at auction. In Windsor, David hears auctioneer Harry Ballin’s estimates before the teams see their items go under the hammer – for a profit or a loss!

programme.title: Tommy Tiernan's Epic West
programme.desc: The west of Ireland has always been a place apart. A raw, wind-whipped land on the farthest edge of Europe, it was the final frontier before the void of the Atlantic Ocean. Existing in the imagination as much as on the map, generations have been lured to this truly special place; from anthropologists to visionary artists, from writers to musicians and film-makers. What are they looking for and what do they find? From the soaring heights of Skellig Michael to the spectacular wilds of Connemara, Tommy’s guides are the art, literature, plays and films created in and about the west of Ireland.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Viewers will be checking their change after watching this episode in Kent! David Harper meets a coin collector who reveals which rare 50 pence piece is worth 300 times its face value! John Wilson’s collection boasts 11,000 coins, including early medieval and Tudor hammered coins and the very first milled ones from the 18th century. Hoping to splash some cash of their own at Detling antiques fair are two teams of bargain hunters. In red are mum and daughter Nisha and dancer Adzi, with their expert Mark Stacey. Their opponents in blue are partners and musicians Kathy and Nardo. Nardo used to play drums in 1980s band Amazulu, and Kathy worked with some big recording artists of the era. They hope to compose a win with expert Kate Bliss, kicking off with a dolphin water feature, but four figures is too much to splash out on. The reds, meanwhile, are pinning their hopes on a set of cameo brooches, but Mark has doubts whether they will prove popular at auction. In Windsor, David hears auctioneer Harry Ballin’s estimates before the teams see their items go under the hammer – for a profit or a loss!

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Viewers will be checking their change after watching this episode in Kent! David Harper meets a coin collector who reveals which rare 50 pence piece is worth 300 times its face value! John Wilson’s collection boasts 11,000 coins, including early medieval and Tudor hammered coins and the very first milled ones from the 18th century. Hoping to splash some cash of their own at Detling antiques fair are two teams of bargain hunters. In red are mum and daughter Nisha and dancer Adzi, with their expert Mark Stacey. Their opponents in blue are partners and musicians Kathy and Nardo. Nardo used to play drums in 1980s band Amazulu, and Kathy worked with some big recording artists of the era. They hope to compose a win with expert Kate Bliss, kicking off with a dolphin water feature, but four figures is too much to splash out on. The reds, meanwhile, are pinning their hopes on a set of cameo brooches, but Mark has doubts whether they will prove popular at auction. In Windsor, David hears auctioneer Harry Ballin’s estimates before the teams see their items go under the hammer – for a profit or a loss!

programme.title: Scotland's Greatest Escape
programme.desc: JJ Chalmers and Grado uncover the best holiday escapes in Scotland. However, it’s up to friends and families from all over Scotland to decide which escapes make it to the grand final. Scotland’s greatest campsite, caravan or chalet escape is decided by the Browns, a fun-loving family of four from central Scotland. With two kids under ten to entertain, how will they rate a night in the treehouses at Lanrick, a secluded, hand-crafted cabin at Arcadia Glamping and a campsite on a remote Hebridean island?

programme.title: Paramedics on Scene
programme.desc: Stevie and Pete of the Special Operations Response Team join the other emergency services at the scene of a man who is threatening to harm himself in a public place. It’s a distressing situation that takes a sudden, unexpected turn. Pete must take action to help rescue the patient and deliver him safely to the care of a local ambulance crew. Serving a community of around 9,000 people, Dunoon-based paramedic Ben is used to the occasional quiet shift. But he has a potentially life-threatening emergency in the shape of Ian, who has a blood clot in his lung. It’s vital the team get him across the Firth of Clyde for specialist care at Inverclyde Hospital - but will they make the last ferry of the night? Meanwhile, in Paisley, ambulance technicians Lewis and Steven take stroke patient John to Glasgow’s Queen Elizabeth Hospital for an emergency thrombectomy. But John’s case brings back difficult memories for Steven, who is living with the recent loss of his father in tragically similar circumstances.

programme.title: Being Stanley Baxter
programme.desc: TV and panto star Stanley Baxter had big success but an even bigger secret. With access to close family and friends, personal archive and recordings, we reveal his true story.

programme.title: Still Game
programme.desc: When Jack and Victor aren't invited to the wedding of the year, they decide to do something about it. Meanwhile Winston has his own plan to get an invite.

programme.title: Two Doors Down
programme.desc: Over at Alan and Michelle’s, Alan’s bullying big brother Michael turns up to sort the rings for his wedding. Meanwhile, Christine catches Michelle on the street and persuades them to come over to Beth’s so they can get a look at the groom. Christine goes on about how handsome and funny Michael is while managing to make everyone else feel inadequate. Especially Alan. With the rings to keep safe, a list of chores to do and Colin showing off his sexy stripper moves, the gathering soon descends into chaos. He may be the best man, but it turns out nobody really has any confidence in Alan’s abilities to do anything other than order two puddings at the meal – let alone make a speech.

programme.desc: Shereen Cutkelvin presents highlights from TRNSMT 2026 weekend including performances from Amy Macdonald, Perrie, The Snuts, Jacob Alon, CMAT, Beluga Lagoon, Becky Hill, Loyle Carner, Wolf Alice and headliners Kasabian.

programme.title: Things You Should Have Done
programme.desc: Stay-at-home-daughter Chi is suddenly forced to fend for herself when her parents die in a car crash. Chi learns she will only inherit the house on condition she completes a list of 'Things You Should Have Done' left in the parents' will, the first of which is, ironically, learn to drive. Meanwhile, Chi's highly strung auntie Karen wants nothing to do with her dependent pest of a niece, but very much wants the house she feels is rightfully hers. Chi ventures out into Ramsgate in search of a driving license and infiltrates the family of a mild-mannered driving instructor in the process.

programme.title: Things You Should Have Done
programme.desc: Chi spectacularly fails a trial period at the pharmacy with Karen, but Dave kindly lets her shadow him on his delivery rounds. On a drop-off to a retirement home, Chi finds her tribe... old people. She also falls in love with Linda, an elderly lady who seems to think Chi is her husband. Elsewhere, Dave has a health scare, and Karen starts to think she might be the fertility issue.

programme.title: Things You Should Have Done
programme.desc: Pancake day is a highly sentimental time for Chi. Dave confides in Lucas about his health scare. They vow to make the most of every moment, and that begins with pancake day.

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: The action shifts to Steve's home turf as the Deadly 60 team scour the UK in search of its lethal beauties. Terry Nutkins lends a helping hand in spotting otters and tells Steve the story of how he lost two fingers to one of these creatures. A bit of pond-dipping reveals a whole host of the nasties ready to bite, maim and generally eat each other, and Steve gets a chance to meet with the biggest spider in the UK. Then it's off for a high-speed chase as Steve plays pigeon for the afternoon and nearly loses his head whilst being hunted by the fastest animal on the planet, the truly incredible peregrine falcon.

programme.title: Marcel the Shell with Shoes On
programme.desc: When struggling film-maker Dean moves into a rental property, he quickly discovers he is not alone. Marcel, an adorable one-inch-tall shell, already lives there with his grandmother Connie and their pet lint Alan. Once part of a sprawling community of shells, Marcel and Connie live alone as the sole survivors of a mysterious tragedy. Taken with his unlikely new friend, Dean starts filming Marcel and his grandmother, igniting a meteoric rise to internet fame that changes their lives forever. But will Marcel’s newfound sense of possibility and a throng of superfans be enough to track down his long-lost family?

programme.title: Ludwig
programme.desc: With new information about Chief Constable Ziegler, John is sent back to the police station to get closer to DI Russell Carter, his brother’s new partner who mysteriously arrived around the same time that James disappeared. A new case takes John and Russell on a walking tour of Cambridge, where they are faced with a conundrum: why would someone kill a tour guide that they’d only just met? To get closer to the truth about what happened to conspiracy blogger Roger Sinclair, Lucy goes undercover and makes a shocking discovery of her own.

programme.title: Amandaland
programme.desc: Amanda meets Mal’s ex Abs for the first time and then discovers that Abs found her shallow. So she decides to use a school careers talk to prove her wrong.

programme.title: Amandaland

programme.title: Cooking Buddies
programme.desc: Buddy and Conker are joined by amazing Irish dancer and Kidz Bop British Sign Language interpreter Maisie! She needs Buddy’s help to make something tasty for her dancer friends to top them up after their energetic rehearsals. The only food that can jump as high as Maisie can are pancakes! So, Buddy makes bright green spinach pancakes stacked between layers of ham and an oozy cheese sauce - delicious and sure to knock the socks off her dancer friends! She can have it ready to go before dance class and simply pop it in the oven when she gets home. Maisie teaches Buddy to fingerspell his name in British Sign Language, and he tries to walk in Maisie’s very fast footsteps as he has a go at Irish dancing. Join Buddy, Conker and Maisie as they make a pancake stack that’s flippin’ delicious and will be sure to put a spring in your step, too! You can get all of Buddy’s recipes, and loads more, at bbc.co.uk/food

programme.desc: Martha and Ollie face off in a legal battle to win custody of Edison, a cuddly lightbulb. Unfortunately Lily and Rufus are hopeless as their lawyers, and Kat is the presiding judge.

programme.title: The Story of Tracy Beaker
programme.desc: Tracy is a kid growing up in a care home. She's loud, she's fiery and, somehow, she's always in trouble. But all she really wants is a home and a family to love...

programme.desc: Nugget plays big sister to a kid penguin for the summer. But when her hyper-energetic plans for fun activities prove unpopular, Pancake suggests an alternative approach.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Gadabout gives himself dance fever to prove he is as much fun as Zog and Pearl. When he can't stop boogieing, they must cure him before sunset so he is not stuck dancing forever!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo only wanted to help fix a satellite dish with Mojo’s chopper top. Now they’ve been mistaken for a UFO, and the whole town is in a tizzy about invading aliens!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: 'If you want to play with a cat you have to make friends with it first.' On the way to Padget's shop, Bing and Flop stop to play with Arlo the cat. Bing loves Arlo and knows just where he likes to be stroked and what games he likes playing. On the way home, Bing spots a new cat but this one isn't so friendly and scares Bing when he tries to play with it.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘bread’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. This episode is all about bread – brown, flat, long, toasted, butterfly and rainbow bread. Dee and a friend roll bread in a ball, and we see a ‘wear it on your head’ bread. The journey is repeated with some surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs are at the seaside building sandcastles. But when one seashell starts to move, they realise it’s no shell at all, but Sailor Nancy - the fanciest crab to ever walk sideways! Can they save Nancy’s fancy sandcastle before the tide comes in?

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Lou explains to Marzipan what hugs are for.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: Ziff, Pipp and Button make a clever telescope and enjoy a magical star-filled adventure.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: A man in a restaurant is looking at his mobile phone. He puts it in his briefcase but it rings again. The Twirlywoos pass the phone to the man every time it rings. It goes in and out of the briefcase. Great BigHoo throws the phone out and it lands in a glass. Toodloo throws the phone out and it lands in the coat pocket. Chickedy and Chick throw the phone out and it lands in the lady's hair. What will it land in next? The Stop-Go Car visits the Twirlywoos. It drives in to Peekaboo's house and then out again. The Stop-Go Car does this over and over again until Peekaboo decides he has had enough and sends the Stop-Go Car out.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Today, Justin visits the vet with his friend's pet dog for a check-up. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble pretends to be a vet for his toy patients.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Preschool series. The Teletubbies eat tubby custard and ride the Tubby Custard Ride around Home Dome. A child in Tummy Tales tries to make his baby sister laugh.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Nigel and Baby Bear welcome babies Francis, Minnie, Theo, Alana, Reau and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their little ones at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Nigel’s got some toy binoculars inside his bag. All the parents and little ones have different park-themed toys and objects too, which are explored through play, songs and a story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to hide a baby-appropriate park-themed objects or toys inside a fabric bag or pillowcase to explore with their baby. Some viewers show how they’ve been having fun at the park too. The fun song Went to the Park One Day features, as does a story about Baby Bear, Baby Tiger and Big Bear going to the rainy park. The Together Song gets everyone moving about before some calm time with sensory scarves and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children paint calming mobiles, learning British Sign Language signs for mama, buy and cry, then sing and sign Hush Little Baby Don’t You Cry.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: Aaron, Nelly and Abbie follow Chatterpot’s slimy trail to discover how slugs and snails love to munch around in the garden and help keep the garden tidy and magical.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Baby rhino Maisha is in a bad mood, but her friends help her feel better. Hamza spots some fantastic colobus monkeys in the trees and searches for clues to find the elephants.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Baby Coconuts fall from trees and learn to walk on sand. Ginger and the Pea-Rexes help.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: At school, Bluey and her friends throw themselves into various games. Teacher Calypso keeps her charges on track with a wise word and a song - all except the mysterious Pretzel.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels hear an echoing voice coming from the top of a castle's spooky tower. Someone is calling them - but who is it? Duggee and the Squirrels go off to investigate, but first they have to get inside the castle. Good job Duggee knows how. Prepare to be taken on a huge chase around the castle before the Squirrels finally discover who is making all that mischief and noise at the top of the castle.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Black and White colour a city with new the help of new friend Grey. Learn to mix different shades of grey with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Brooke finds out all about one of the UK’s favourite birds – robins. Chantelle is with Kabir at a nature reserve listening out for different kinds of birds while Rory and his son Sandy are in the garden digging for worms and bird spotting. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files explain why robins have a red breast, what colour robin chicks are and why robins are on Christmas cards. It’s also time to find out what robins do for the planet as pest controllers. This episode’s Teeny Tiny Task is to help the birds by making a bird feeder.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Ted wants to camp out in the garden, and with sister Sofia’s help he puts up a tent for them both to sleep in. Dad’s in charge of the barbecue and cooks up a yummy camping feast of hot dogs and toasted marshmallows. Before they settle down for a night in the great outdoors, Ted and his family talk about some of the nocturnal animals they may hear during the night.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Jen finds a message in a bottle in the washing up, and Small believes it’s from Pirate Tiny Spoon. While on a treasure hunt, they get a visit from Peanut the Parrot and make her a treasure pie recipe.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Tinks is a disability assistance dog for her owner Charli, who has a condition that makes it painful for her to pick things up or to push and pull things. Tinks uses her super fetch skills to help Charli every day. Charli is helping park ranger Pauline with some litter picking in Woofton Park. First they have to travel across the tricky terrain in the park to meet Pauline, so she can give them the instructions and equipment they need. Tinks persuades Charli to use the motor on Charli’s wheelchair at turbo speed! Tinks helps Charli find the litter, but the gate to the recycling bins is locked, and the recycling van is on its way. Can Tinks fetch park ranger Pauline in time to recycle their rubbish?

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: The class has a visit from Karen, the dental nurse, who shows them how to keep their teeth clean. She asks Jud to be a pretend dentist and give Oliver’s teeth a check-over, but how many teeth does he have? Jud, Oliver and Jessica are then given the chance to practise their brushing skills with Karen. She gives them some top tips to make sure they always have gleaming white smiles. Solomon is in the dental surgery role play area. First, it’s his turn to be a dentist and Mrs Hussain is the patient, then they swap roles. After lunch, Mrs Farrell and the children try out the skills they’ve learnt by giving their teeth a brush.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Phoenix eagerly joins puffin practice with Oona, Isabelle and Baba, who are digging, walking and fishing! Phoenix is very excited to learn, but he doubts himself when he can’t do everything the puffins can. But when the seagulls cause trouble, Phoenix's own talents save the day!

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Lu feels discouraged when her xylophone playing doesn't get the reaction she'd hoped for.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: When the wind snatches Maddie's paper bird away, Maddie is disappointed and wonders what the wind is good for. The wind blows Maddie and Triggs away – literally and metaphorically – with a song that demonstrates her awesome power.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Keith is on the way to his first music lesson with Brian, but a wild air stream blocks the path, sweeping everyone away! The Piggies must help him cross, but they can’t agree on which materials to use. Can they solve the problem before it’s too late?

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: One and her chums carefully cross the pattern puzzle paths over the magic moats to get to the Pattern Palace. Learn about patterns with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Z likes a good snooze, filling the air with floaty zeds - but when Z zaps his zeds, young Y and his yak set off on a quest to find them. This episode introduces the letters Y and Z and the double letters ZZ, and the words zap, yak, yap, yell, jazz and zigzag.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Mr Tumble makes breakfast for Tumble Ted, while Justin and his friends collect eggs for their breakfast.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: It's a windy day in Teletubbyland and Dipsy's hat blows away. Po helps Dipsy get the hat back, while in Tummy Tales, children have fun playing on a windy beach.

programme.title: Andy's Prehistoric Adventures
programme.desc: Andy plunges into an underwater prehistoric adventure, 150 million years back in time, as he searches for a swimming reptile that's the size of an elephant! But after being chased by a scary shark, he finds himself lost at sea.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s Stall. She chooses the ‘marry me’ note and remembers the day she got it. James confides in Molly that today is the day he’s going to ask Alice to marry him. However, Molly doesn’t think James’ plan is special enough. She assures her dad that she and Mack will come up with a plan for the perfect way to propose to Alice. Elsewhere in the Hub, Caitlin and Euan are delivering ‘happy notes’ to people. Unfortunately, the ‘marry me’ note that Molly writes for James gets delivered mistakenly to Moira, and she gets the wrong end of the stick! Meanwhile, the engagement ring has been locked inside a cashbox for safety, but James can’t find the combination for the lock. As Alice arrives to meet James for her super special surprise, Molly’s idea takes shape, and soon Alice gives James an answer to his question.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies’ very own motorcycle rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that need a lot of balance. Grace takes a velodrome bike for a spin, shows off a supercool hoverboard and takes some electric rollerskates for a spin.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: An unexpected visitor has arrived in the playground - a cat! The pups are initially scared. After all, they’ve heard that cats have lasers for eyes. But Dodge decides to be brave and talk to it. Dodge discovers the cat is friendly and isn’t anything like how the pups had imagined, she’s just lost. The pups decide to help her find her way to Kitten School.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger teaches the baby Pea-Rexes a new survival skill through a game of hide-and-seek.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: When a sea turtle loses a chunk of its shell, Tweak and Bud must engineer a solution.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Benjamin finds a four-leaf clover, Peter tricks him into thinking it brings good luck. It's harmless fun until Peter's prank accidentally leads Lily into Mr Tod's dangerous clutches!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it’s King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that ‘finding their talents’ means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: It’s Healthy Fur Day, and all the animals in Sweetwood are coming to Vida’s clinic to get groomed - except Zigzag, a bunny with some serious knots in her fluffy tail.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: The Cobs have finally had enough of Evil Pea’s ungratefulness and team up with Supertato.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy keeps wrecking the Ducklings' playground with his remote-controlled car, so they use an invention from the Farm of the Future to create a barrier - but Weasy steals it to use for his own game!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Preston needs Mojo’s racer top speed to get his new plane off the ground. But when his flight goes wrong, Mojo and Bo have to take to the air in Mojo’s jet top to help him down!

programme.desc: Lucky’s dad changes the rules of pass the parcel back to having one prize in the middle.

programme.desc: In a new game, Dad is unprepared for the realities of giving birth to a baby Bingo.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: When Mara calls Pearl sensible, she wants to prove how fun she is. With her eye off the ball, Pearl starts to make medical mistakes. Can she be a fun doctor?

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: Taran wants to play football with his dad. Rajinder gives him newly invented training boots instead of playing, until he realises Taran only wants a simple kickabout.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Ruby and Finn’s seeds have started to grow, but Rafi’s cherry seed shows no change. Feeling left out, she makes a wish, and a giant cherry tree appears! It’s exciting at first, but when the wish ends, everything disappears. Rafi feels sad, until Doris shares a story about planting an apple tree when she was little. Rafi realises that nature likes to take its time and waiting can bring something special.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran bump into Ned and Monty as they walk along the canal. Ned invites them onboard to go on a boat ride, where JoJo gets to act as captain – on the lookout for treasure! They go past many locations along the canal, including a park and the zoo, before getting an ice cream! JoJo learns that people can live on boats.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah and Duck invite some friends over for a sleepover, but getting to sleep is tougher than planned.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Major Clanger has invented a machine for cleaning up the planet. But when he gets called away by Granny, Small and Tiny can't resist trying it for themselves. Unfortunately, it proves harder to control than they thought, and they accidentally suck up a swarm of Glow Buzzers. It takes all of Small and Tiny's ingenuity to rescue them!

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa are doing a funny dance when a leaf sticks to MeMo’s foot. MeMo tries to shake it off, but it attaches to BaBa. The sticky leaf comes with them to the Play Tree, where they play with a dancing flower while doing the sticky leaf dance. The Yummies get stuck to the sticky leaf, so MeMo and BaBa help to free them. At Storytime, Gramma Leeba uses the sticky leaf as a bookmark.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: The Tombliboos have a very busy day. First they ride on the Pinky Ponk and then they explore the garden, seeing lots of interesting things and having fun. Finally, they return to the house to clean their teeth before bedtime.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Director Sir Sam Mendes reads the story of Joe, a boy with green fingers and a wild imagination.

programme.desc: Lisa and the children paint calming mobiles, learning British Sign Language signs for mama, buy and cry, then sing and sign Hush Little Baby Don’t You Cry.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: Aaron, Nelly and Abbie follow Chatterpot’s slimy trail to discover how slugs and snails love to munch around in the garden and help keep the garden tidy and magical.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Baby rhino Maisha is in a bad mood, but her friends help her feel better. Hamza spots some fantastic colobus monkeys in the trees and searches for clues to find the elephants.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Baby Coconuts fall from trees and learn to walk on sand. Ginger and the Pea-Rexes help.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: At school, Bluey and her friends throw themselves into various games. Teacher Calypso keeps her charges on track with a wise word and a song - all except the mysterious Pretzel.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels hear an echoing voice coming from the top of a castle's spooky tower. Someone is calling them - but who is it? Duggee and the Squirrels go off to investigate, but first they have to get inside the castle. Good job Duggee knows how. Prepare to be taken on a huge chase around the castle before the Squirrels finally discover who is making all that mischief and noise at the top of the castle.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Black and White colour a city with new the help of new friend Grey. Learn to mix different shades of grey with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Brooke finds out all about one of the UK’s favourite birds – robins. Chantelle is with Kabir at a nature reserve listening out for different kinds of birds while Rory and his son Sandy are in the garden digging for worms and bird spotting. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files explain why robins have a red breast, what colour robin chicks are and why robins are on Christmas cards. It’s also time to find out what robins do for the planet as pest controllers. This episode’s Teeny Tiny Task is to help the birds by making a bird feeder.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Ted wants to camp out in the garden, and with sister Sofia’s help he puts up a tent for them both to sleep in. Dad’s in charge of the barbecue and cooks up a yummy camping feast of hot dogs and toasted marshmallows. Before they settle down for a night in the great outdoors, Ted and his family talk about some of the nocturnal animals they may hear during the night.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Jen finds a message in a bottle in the washing up, and Small believes it’s from Pirate Tiny Spoon. While on a treasure hunt, they get a visit from Peanut the Parrot and make her a treasure pie recipe.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Tinks is a disability assistance dog for her owner Charli, who has a condition that makes it painful for her to pick things up or to push and pull things. Tinks uses her super fetch skills to help Charli every day. Charli is helping park ranger Pauline with some litter picking in Woofton Park. First they have to travel across the tricky terrain in the park to meet Pauline, so she can give them the instructions and equipment they need. Tinks persuades Charli to use the motor on Charli’s wheelchair at turbo speed! Tinks helps Charli find the litter, but the gate to the recycling bins is locked, and the recycling van is on its way. Can Tinks fetch park ranger Pauline in time to recycle their rubbish?

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: The class has a visit from Karen, the dental nurse, who shows them how to keep their teeth clean. She asks Jud to be a pretend dentist and give Oliver’s teeth a check-over, but how many teeth does he have? Jud, Oliver and Jessica are then given the chance to practise their brushing skills with Karen. She gives them some top tips to make sure they always have gleaming white smiles. Solomon is in the dental surgery role play area. First, it’s his turn to be a dentist and Mrs Hussain is the patient, then they swap roles. After lunch, Mrs Farrell and the children try out the skills they’ve learnt by giving their teeth a brush.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Phoenix eagerly joins puffin practice with Oona, Isabelle and Baba, who are digging, walking and fishing! Phoenix is very excited to learn, but he doubts himself when he can’t do everything the puffins can. But when the seagulls cause trouble, Phoenix's own talents save the day!

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Lu feels discouraged when her xylophone playing doesn't get the reaction she'd hoped for.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: When the wind snatches Maddie's paper bird away, Maddie is disappointed and wonders what the wind is good for. The wind blows Maddie and Triggs away – literally and metaphorically – with a song that demonstrates her awesome power.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Keith is on the way to his first music lesson with Brian, but a wild air stream blocks the path, sweeping everyone away! The Piggies must help him cross, but they can’t agree on which materials to use. Can they solve the problem before it’s too late?

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: One and her chums carefully cross the pattern puzzle paths over the magic moats to get to the Pattern Palace. Learn about patterns with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Z likes a good snooze, filling the air with floaty zeds - but when Z zaps his zeds, young Y and his yak set off on a quest to find them. This episode introduces the letters Y and Z and the double letters ZZ, and the words zap, yak, yap, yell, jazz and zigzag.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Mr Tumble makes breakfast for Tumble Ted, while Justin and his friends collect eggs for their breakfast.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: It's a windy day in Teletubbyland and Dipsy's hat blows away. Po helps Dipsy get the hat back, while in Tummy Tales, children have fun playing on a windy beach.

programme.title: Andy's Prehistoric Adventures
programme.desc: Andy plunges into an underwater prehistoric adventure, 150 million years back in time, as he searches for a swimming reptile that's the size of an elephant! But after being chased by a scary shark, he finds himself lost at sea.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s Stall. She chooses the ‘marry me’ note and remembers the day she got it. James confides in Molly that today is the day he’s going to ask Alice to marry him. However, Molly doesn’t think James’ plan is special enough. She assures her dad that she and Mack will come up with a plan for the perfect way to propose to Alice. Elsewhere in the Hub, Caitlin and Euan are delivering ‘happy notes’ to people. Unfortunately, the ‘marry me’ note that Molly writes for James gets delivered mistakenly to Moira, and she gets the wrong end of the stick! Meanwhile, the engagement ring has been locked inside a cashbox for safety, but James can’t find the combination for the lock. As Alice arrives to meet James for her super special surprise, Molly’s idea takes shape, and soon Alice gives James an answer to his question.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies’ very own motorcycle rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that need a lot of balance. Grace takes a velodrome bike for a spin, shows off a supercool hoverboard and takes some electric rollerskates for a spin.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: An unexpected visitor has arrived in the playground - a cat! The pups are initially scared. After all, they’ve heard that cats have lasers for eyes. But Dodge decides to be brave and talk to it. Dodge discovers the cat is friendly and isn’t anything like how the pups had imagined, she’s just lost. The pups decide to help her find her way to Kitten School.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger teaches the baby Pea-Rexes a new survival skill through a game of hide-and-seek.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: When a sea turtle loses a chunk of its shell, Tweak and Bud must engineer a solution.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Benjamin finds a four-leaf clover, Peter tricks him into thinking it brings good luck. It's harmless fun until Peter's prank accidentally leads Lily into Mr Tod's dangerous clutches!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it’s King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that ‘finding their talents’ means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: It’s Healthy Fur Day, and all the animals in Sweetwood are coming to Vida’s clinic to get groomed - except Zigzag, a bunny with some serious knots in her fluffy tail.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: The Cobs have finally had enough of Evil Pea’s ungratefulness and team up with Supertato.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy keeps wrecking the Ducklings' playground with his remote-controlled car, so they use an invention from the Farm of the Future to create a barrier - but Weasy steals it to use for his own game!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Preston needs Mojo’s racer top speed to get his new plane off the ground. But when his flight goes wrong, Mojo and Bo have to take to the air in Mojo’s jet top to help him down!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Lucky’s dad changes the rules of pass the parcel back to having one prize in the middle.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In a new game, Dad is unprepared for the realities of giving birth to a baby Bingo.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: When Mara calls Pearl sensible, she wants to prove how fun she is. With her eye off the ball, Pearl starts to make medical mistakes. Can she be a fun doctor?

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: Taran wants to play football with his dad. Rajinder gives him newly invented training boots instead of playing, until he realises Taran only wants a simple kickabout.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog

programme.desc: Ruby and Finn’s seeds have started to grow, but Rafi’s cherry seed shows no change. Feeling left out, she makes a wish, and a giant cherry tree appears! It’s exciting at first, but when the wish ends, everything disappears. Rafi feels sad, until Doris shares a story about planting an apple tree when she was little. Rafi realises that nature likes to take its time and waiting can bring something special.

Ned invites them onboard to go on a boat ride, where JoJo gets to act as captain – on the lookout for treasure! They go past many locations along the canal, including a park and the zoo, before getting an ice cream! JoJo learns that people can live on boats.

programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah and Duck invite some friends over for a sleepover, but getting to sleep is tougher than planned.

programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa are doing a funny dance when a leaf sticks to MeMo’s foot. MeMo tries to shake it off, but it attaches to BaBa. programme.title: Killer In The House
programme.desc: The extraordinary true story of an almost perfect murder, this documentary examines the case of one of the UK's most notorious double killings. Colin Howell is a married dentist with four children and a pillar of the Baptist community in Coleraine in Northern Ireland, but he's having an affair with married Sunday school teacher Hazel Buchanan - they agree the only way they can be together is if they murder their spouses. Howell devises a plot to poison them with carbon monoxide fumes and then stage their deaths as a double suicide - unbelievably, the police believe the lie and Colin and Hazel get away with murder. Nearly 20 years later, Colin suffers a crisis of conscience - convinced he's being punished by God, he confesses to the murders with devastating consequences. For the first time, the three children of Colin and Lesley Howell speak about life growing up with a father who they later discovered was a murderer - and of the enormous impact this shocking crime has had on them.

programme.title: Killer In The House
programme.desc: The extraordinary true story of an almost perfect murder, this documentary examines the case of one of the UK's most notorious double killings. Colin Howell is a married dentist with four children and a pillar of the Baptist community in Coleraine in Northern Ireland, but he's having an affair with married Sunday school teacher Hazel Buchanan - they agree the only way they can be together is if they murder their spouses. Howell devises a plot to poison them with carbon monoxide fumes and then stage their deaths as a double suicide - unbelievably, the police believe the lie and Colin and Hazel get away with murder. Nearly 20 years later, Colin suffers a crisis of conscience - convinced he's being punished by God, he confesses to the murders with devastating consequences. For the first time, the three children of Colin and Lesley Howell speak about life growing up with a father who they later discovered was a murderer - and of the enormous impact this shocking crime has had on them.

programme.title: Killer In The House
programme.desc: The extraordinary true story of an almost perfect murder, this documentary examines the case of one of the UK's most notorious double killings. Colin Howell is a married dentist with four children and a pillar of the Baptist community in Coleraine in Northern Ireland, but he's having an affair with married Sunday school teacher Hazel Buchanan - they agree the only way they can be together is if they murder their spouses. Howell devises a plot to poison them with carbon monoxide fumes and then stage their deaths as a double suicide - unbelievably, the police believe the lie and Colin and Hazel get away with murder. Nearly 20 years later, Colin suffers a crisis of conscience - convinced he's being punished by God, he confesses to the murders with devastating consequences. For the first time, the three children of Colin and Lesley Howell speak about life growing up with a father who they later discovered was a murderer - and of the enormous impact this shocking crime has had on them.

programme.title: Killer In The House
programme.desc: The extraordinary true story of an almost perfect murder, this documentary examines the case of one of the UK's most notorious double killings. Colin Howell is a married dentist with four children and a pillar of the Baptist community in Coleraine in Northern Ireland, but he's having an affair with married Sunday school teacher Hazel Buchanan - they agree the only way they can be together is if they murder their spouses. Howell devises a plot to poison them with carbon monoxide fumes and then stage their deaths as a double suicide - unbelievably, the police believe the lie and Colin and Hazel get away with murder. Nearly 20 years later, Colin suffers a crisis of conscience - convinced he's being punished by God, he confesses to the murders with devastating consequences. For the first time, the three children of Colin and Lesley Howell speak about life growing up with a father who they later discovered was a murderer - and of the enormous impact this shocking crime has had on them.

programme.title: Killer In The House
programme.desc: The extraordinary true story of an almost perfect murder, this documentary examines the case of one of the UK's most notorious double killings. Colin Howell is a married dentist with four children and a pillar of the Baptist community in Coleraine in Northern Ireland, but he's having an affair with married Sunday school teacher Hazel Buchanan - they agree the only way they can be together is if they murder their spouses. Howell devises a plot to poison them with carbon monoxide fumes and then stage their deaths as a double suicide - unbelievably, the police believe the lie and Colin and Hazel get away with murder. Nearly 20 years later, Colin suffers a crisis of conscience - convinced he's being punished by God, he confesses to the murders with devastating consequences. For the first time, the three children of Colin and Lesley Howell speak about life growing up with a father who they later discovered was a murderer - and of the enormous impact this shocking crime has had on them.
